_comment: GES DISC alerts (checked against https://disc.gsfc.nasa.gov/api/alerts on 2026-11-15). Update when GES DISC posts changes. 'outage_giovanni_prefixes' makes the router skip Giovanni for those variable IDs and use the monthly Cloud OPeNDAP fallback; only list prefixes that HAVE a fallback, otherwise the variable becomes unroutable.

alerts.message: GES DISC reported a temporary outage of some cloud Giovanni variables (AIRS3STD 7.0, GLDAS_NOAH025_3H 2.1, IMERG DE/DL/HHE/HHL, OMI daily products) from 24 to 30 June 2026; that alert has expired. For the listed hourly/3-hourly/half-hourly collections this tool still uses the monthly Cloud OPeNDAP collection, which needs fewer requests.

source_alert.title: Temporary Outage of Cloud Giovanni Variables

alerts.message: Ocean grid cells are masked for land-model variables (GLDAS, NLDAS). Choose land regions for these variables.
A spurious-zeros bug before 2024-01-01 in GLDAS 3H, MERRA-2 and NLDAS series was fixed on 2026-03-26. Cached data retrieved before that date should be refreshed.
